verses.text: Manh heyal esal lolonel t'a spatik heb' heyetanima'il. Manh junnhejok tzeyutej he b'a yet' junok mach chuk spensar yik tzeyak'anoch he b'a testigo'al t'a tas manh yelok.
Manh heyak'och he b'a yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh heyak'och he b'a testigo'al t'a es yet' heb' anima sk'ulan chukal.
Wach'chom meb'a' junok anima, palta tato ay smul, manh heyak' och he b'a yet'ok.
Tato ha junok winh ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex ay junok nok' swakax, ma nok' sb'uru satnakb'ati, tz'ilchaj nok' heyu'uj, ik'ekb'at nok' t'a winh.
Yowalil tzex kolwaj t'a mach schichonoch sk'o'ol t'ayex. Tato tzeyila' to stelwi nok' sb'uru t'a yalanh yikatz, tzeyik'k'e wa'an nok' yet'ok.
Tato ay junok anima meb'a' snib'ej sch'olb'itaj yaj yowal, manh he tenek' t'ay.
Manh he cha junok esal lolonel t'a spatik junok anima. Manh heyak'och chamel t'a yib'anh junok anima malaj smul, yujto ha hin ol wak' spak t'a mach icha chi' sk'ulej.
Manh he cha k'e'en tumin t'a elk'altak yik tze b'o'an yaj junok owal, yujto ha yuj k'e'en tumin chi' tzeyak' musansatil he b'a, tze k'exankan tas tojol t'a tas manh tojolok.
Manh heyixtej anima ch'ok chonhab'il, yujto ha hex tik najtil ix hex ek' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a Egipto. Heyojtakxo syahelal tz'utaj anima t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Wake' ab'il tzex munlaj t'a sat lum lum, tze molank'e sat tas tzeyawej.

Haxo t'a yukil ab'il, tzeyaktankan lu'um. Ha jantakto tastak sk'ib'k'e t'a sat lu'um, yikxo heb' meb'a' ayek' t'a yol he chonhab' chi' yet' nok' k'ultakil nok'. Wach'chom te' heyuwa ma te' heyolivo, manhxo he mesa'.

Wake' k'uhalnhej tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yukil k'uhal tzeyik'an heyip. Yet' pax nok' he wakax, nok' he b'uru yet' heb' he chekab' tz'alji t'a yol he cuenta yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il smunlaj heyet'ok syik'pax yip.
k'anab'ajejek masanil tas ix wal tik t'ayex. Manh heyal he b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios, manh he lokpax sb'i.
Oxel tzeyak'och k'inh t'a yol junjun ab'il yik tzin heyik'ancha'anh.

Ha t'a uj Abib tzeyak'och sk'inhal ixim pan malaj yich, icha ix wutej walan t'ayex. T'a uke' k'uhal tze wa ixim pan malaj yich, yujto ha t'a jun uj chi' ix hex elta t'a Egipto. Malajokab' junok mach sja t'a wichanh tato malaj jab'ok yofrenda yet'nak.
Tzeyak'anpaxoch k'inh ayik tz'elul sb'ab'el sat tas tzeyawej. Hanheja' tzeyak'anpaxoch junxo k'inh ayik slajwikank'e masanil sat tastak tzeyawej chi'.
Ha hin Jehová he Yajalil hin tik swala' to ha t'a oxe' k'inh chi' yowalil sjawi masanil heb' winh winak t'a wichanh.
Ayik tzeyak'an nok' nok' silab'il t'ayin, manh heyak'laj schik'il nok' yet' ixim pan ayb'at yich. Manh he sik'b'at xepu'al nok' silab' chi' t'a junokxo k'uhal.
Ha wal sb'ab'el sat heyawb'en wach' tz'el t'a sat lum lum, ha' tzeyik'b'at t'a hin kajnub', ha hin Jehová he Diosal hin swala'. Manh he tz'anh nok' yunetak chiwa t'a skal yal yim snun.
Ol hin chekb'at jun wángel t'a heyichanh yik wach' tzex tanhwaj yuj t'a yoltak b'e, ol hex yik'anb'at t'a jun lugar b'aj wach'xo yaj wu'uj, b'aj ol hex ajok.
Scham wal heyilani, manh he pitej he b'a t'ay, palta tze k'anab'ajej tas syala'. Ichato ha' ol munlaj hin k'exulok, manh ol hex yak'laj niwank'olal tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej t'ay.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej t'ay, tze k'ulan tas syal t'a hin k'exulok, ol hin och ajk'olal t'a mach ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex. Ol hin och tek'tek' t'a yichanh mach snib'ej stek'b'ej sb'a t'a heyichanh.

Ha jun wángel chi' ol b'ab'laj t'a heyichanh. Ol hex yik'anb'at t'a sat lum slu'um heb' amorreo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' cananeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo. Jun'elnhej ol hin satkanel heb'.

Manh hex em nhojan t'a yichanh sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Manh hex empax kuman t'ay, manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' chonhab' chi' t'a heyik'ancha'anh sdiosal heb'. Ha tas smoj tze k'ulej, to tze mak'poj sdiosal heb' chi' yet' masanil k'e'en k'e'en ayoch t'ay.
Ha hinnhej Jehová he Diosal hin b'aj tzeyak'em he b'a. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, ol wak' tas tze wa'a yet' tas tzeyuk'ej. Najat pax ol wik'el ilya t'a he kal.
Najat pax ol wutok he k 'inal. Ha t'a yol junjun he chonhab'il chi', malaj junok ix ix tonhej ol el yune', manh junok heb' ix to manh ol unewok.
Ol wak' xiwk'e sk'o'ol heb' anima tzex chakani. Ol wak' somchaj spensar heb' chonhab' tzeyak' owal yet'ok yet' masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, ol el lemnaj heb' t'ayex.
Ol wak' somchaj sk'o'ol heb' heyajk'o'ol yuj xiwelal ayik manto hex k'ochlaj, yuj chi' ol el lemnaj heb' heveo, heb' cananeo yet' pax heb' hitita t'ayex.
Manh junoknhej ab'il ol aj wik'anel heb' t'a heyichanh, yik wach' max ixtaxb'at lum lum yik manh ol te k'ib'pax sb'isul nok' k'ultakil nok' tz'ak'an chukal t'ayex.
k'ojank'olalnhej ol aj wik'anel heb' anima chi' t'a sat lu'um, masanto ayik ol k'ib' he b'isul, yik tze makan lum masanil.

Toxo ix wak'kanem stz'akanhil b'aj ol ek' lum he lu'um chi'. Scha'el yich b'aj ay ha' Chakchak Mar, masanto sk'och t'a ha' Éufrates, sb'atxonhej t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo, masanto t'a takinh lu'um. Ol wak'anoch heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um chi' t'a yol he k'ab'. Ha hexxo ol he pechel heb' t'a sat lu'um chi'.
Manh wal he b'o junok he trato yet' heb', manh hex ochpax ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb'.

Manhxo pax he chakan heb' t'a yol he chonhab', yik wach' max hex skuchb'ej heb' he k'ulan chukal t'ayin. Tato tzeyak'em he b'a t'a sdiosal heb' chi', ha hex wal tzeyixtejb'at he b'a syal chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
